user.title: Heating curve optimizer
user.description: Pick the boiler's ViCare entities. The optimizer starts in dry-run mode: it changes nothing while the "Automatic adjustment" switch is off.

abort.already_configured: This heating circuit is already configured.

data.heating_limit: No sampling above this outdoor temperature

rooms_weather.name: Rooms and weather
rooms_weather.description: Multi-room mode: the curve is tuned for the hardest room to heat among those calling for heat. The solar filter ignores samples while the sun heats the house.

pilot.name: Setpoint pilot
pilot.description: Enabled from the panel (Schedule tab) or the "Setpoint pilot" entity. During comfort periods the setpoint drops to standby when no room calls for heat. ViCare quota: 1,450 calls per day, ~1,440 of them used by ViCare's own polling (every minute). With the optimizer refreshing every 5 min (~290 calls), the write budget can go up to 30-40.

data.sun_anticipation: Lower by 1 °C when strong sun is forecast
data.write_budget: ViCare writes allowed per day (pilot, curve, hot water)
data.vicare_refresh_minutes: Refresh ViCare every … min (0 = ViCare polls by itself every minute)

costs_report.name: Costs and weekly report
costs_report.description: Gas price per kWh (from your bill, standing charge excluded) and calorific value (kWh per m³, on the bill, usually 10.5 to 11.5).

data.gas_meter: Gas meter (Gazpar…), takes precedence over ViCare readings

billing.name: Bill and instalments
billing.description: To forecast the yearly settlement. Values from your bill and payment schedule: period start, monthly instalment, number of instalments, yearly standing charge and fixed taxes incl. VAT, reference consumption.

data.fixed_annual_cost: Yearly standing charge and fixed taxes incl. VAT

alerts.name: Boiler alerts
alerts.description: Pressure, unreachable boiler, frost protection, short cycling, overconsumption versus the thermal model, slow pressure loss, service due date ("Service done" button).

data.short_cycle_minutes: Alert below this burner cycle length

dhw.name: Hot water: anti-legionella boost
dhw.description: Enabled by the "Weekly anti-legionella boost" switch. The hot water setpoint is raised, then restored.

data.settle_minutes: Settling time after a program / setpoint / curve change
data.min_outside_spread: Outdoor temperature range needed to change the slope
